title: Replace with a concise goal title
statement: Describe the measurable outcome to achieve, not only the feature to build.
problem: Describe the current user or business problem and why it matters now.

desiredOutcomes.outcome: Describe the observable user or business outcome.

nonGoals: State one explicit boundary that prevents uncontrolled scope growth.

strategic: State the product or business direction that must not be violated.
time: State the deadline or iteration timebox.
budget: State the engineering, model, tool, or operating budget.
technical: State platform, compatibility, deployment, or architecture constraints.
securityAndCompliance: State data, permission, privacy, security, or compliance constraints.

successCriteria.description: Describe the observable condition that proves the goal is met.
successCriteria.target: State the target value or threshold.
successCriteria.evidence: State the test, runtime evidence, user acceptance, or metric source.

metrics.name: Name the primary metric
metrics.baseline: State the current value or the first-baseline collection method.
metrics.target: State the expected change and decision threshold.
metrics.dataSource: State the log, analytics, experiment, feedback, or acceptance source.
metrics.observationWindow: State when and for how long the metric is observed.

assumptions.validationMethod: State the smallest experiment, spike, or evidence needed.
